1.  Sri Bhuvnesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the juvenile/applicant submits that the applicant is aggrieved by the order dated 17.04.2025 passed by the learned Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.28 Agra, whereby two trials have been connected.

sentences.text: Learned counsel relying on Section 23 of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children), Act, 2015, wherein there is a specific bar of joint proceedings of child in conflict with law and person not a child.

sentences.text:
Therefore,
he seeks interference to quash the order dated 17.04.2025 passed by the learned Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.28 Agra in Session Case No.1986 of 2023.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.28 Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned A.G.A. has accepted notice on behalf of State.
3. Sri Abhishek Tiwari, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 appears and submits that he agreed to grievance made by the applicant.

4. None appears for the opposite party nos.2 and 3.
5.

There is no point in issuing notice to opposite party nos.5 and 6.
6.
This Court has considered that the trial court has clubbed two cases together for trial.
7. It is by the order dated 10.10.2023 passed by the learned Juvenile Justice Board, Agra that the matter has been sent to the Children Court for trial.
In such circumstances, Section 23 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children), Act, 2015 prevent the joint trial.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children), Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The same is reproduced as below:-
"No joint proceedings of child in conflict with law and person not a child.
Notwithstanding anything contained in section 223 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 or in any other law for the time being in force
, there shall be no joint proceedings of a child alleged to be in conflict with law, with a person who is not a child.

If during the inquiry by the Board or by the Children's Court, the person alleged to be in conflict with law is found that he is not a child, such person shall not be tried along with a child."
8.

In such circumstances, the order dated 17.04.2025 passed by the learned Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.28 Agra in Session Case No.1986 of 2023 (State Vs.
Prakhar Gupta and another), arising out of Crime No.399 of 2023, under Sections 302, 201/34, 376 IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Sikandera, District Agra is hereby set aside.
